title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit — upward difference
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute snapshot debit — If the final corrected net target exceeds original net plus signed correction adjustments, post exactly that excess as one positive debit correction rounded half-up to two USD decimals; otherwise make no upward posting. This scope requires original approved untaxed or verified-exempt treatment, so amount equals pretax net amount and tax amount is zero.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot debit — upward difference?**

If the final corrected net target exceeds original net plus signed correction adjustments, post exactly that excess as one positive debit correction rounded half-up to two USD decimals; otherwise make no upward posting. This scope requires original approved untaxed or verified-exempt treatment, so amount equals pretax net amount and tax amount is zero.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the final target is 42.50 USD, original net is 30 USD and signed previous corrections total 5 USD. Post a positive debit of 7.50 USD. At a target of 35 USD equality gives no upward posting.
